messages.subject: reactiveValues() and req()
parts:
I seek to use a reactiveValues() object to track an input value
and use it to conditionally (upon change in input value) call req(FALSE) to blank out a plot. Something like:

inputVals <- reactiveValues(prev = 0, curr = 0) # initialize

inputVals$prev <-  inputVals$curr
inputVals$curr <- input$value 

  output$XXX <- renderPlot({
    req(inputVals$prev != inputVals$curr)
    PPplot10()
  }) 

Questions

1. Where, in 3 file app, should a reactiveValues() object  be initialized?

2. How to rewrite above code, such that req(FALSE) blanks out the plot?

Thank you!

This is relevant for #1 too:
http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/scoping.html

And for #2, your code looks fine as-is. The default behavior of req() is to blank out whatever output is rendering, if any.
